questions.knowledge_point: Simplifying Symbolic Statements Using the Commutative Law
questions.problem: Which expression is equivalent to $(M∧N)∨R?$
questions.worked_solution:
By the commutative law, $M∧N≡N∧M.$

Therefore, $(M∧N)∨R≡(N∧M)∨R.$

Finally, by the commutative law, we have

$$
(N∧M)∨R≡R∨(N∧M).
$$
